strategy: parallel isolated diagnosis, evidence collection, single integration gate

agents.specialty: Clerk authentication, multi-tenant RBAC, organization onboarding and authorization
RFQ, supplier quotes, PO, GRN, invoice, settlement, maker-checker
regression, unit tests, root-cause isolation and repeatability
click-first five-role portals, browser routing, onboarding, accessibility
TypeScript, Next.js build, runtime packaging, deployment readiness
PostgreSQL/Prisma migrations, tenant data and immutable ledgers

coordination.integration: No independent agent may merge or deploy. Integrator must reconcile every diagnosis and verify full CI, E2E, Neon backup and production gate.
coordination.constraints: Never expose secrets, bypass role checks, mutate production data during tests, or fabricate acceptance evidence.
coordination.resolution: Capture reproducible failures, identify causal component, add regression test, repair on isolated branch, rerun targeted then global tests, update cumulative backlog with evidence.
